[PHES-EF]{.hero-acronym}

# Public Health Environmental Surveillance Evaluation Framework {.hero-title .unlisted}
:::
::::

<!-- HOME PAGE TEXT -->

::: justify-text
PHES-EF is an international consensus study that will develop a comprehensive framework to evaluate public health environmental surveillance systems. We will use wastewater-based surveillance as our primary example.

<b>Our approach:</b> We will use the Delphi method—an iterative survey process using structured feedback and expert anonymity to build consensus. A diverse panel of global experts will help us create an evidence-informed framework for assessing surveillance system performance. [Learn more about the e-Delphi study.](delphi.qmd)

<b>Next steps:</b> We will finalize the list of candidate items this fall. Registration for e-Delphi panellists will open in January 2027, Round 1 of the survey will run in March 2027 and Round 2 will run from April to May 2027.

::: cta-box
<b>Want to participate?</b> [Contact us](contact.qmd)
:::
:::

### Updated study timeline {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Registration for e-Delphi panellists will open in January 2027. Round 1 will run in March 2027, Round 2 from April to May 2027, and the consensus meeting will be held in September or October 2027.

[See the timeline →](methods.qmd#timeline){.news-link}

### Study protocol published in PLOS ONE {.unnumbered .unlisted}

[Read the protocol →](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0310342){.news-link}
